facts.fact: ICAP says PEPFAR, through CDC, has funded since 2019 the National University of Lesotho's support to the Ministry of Health's digital health systems, including DHIS2 training of 518 users in 10 districts in 2021-2022.
ICAP says NUL co-led DHIS2 training for 518 users from across the 10 districts in 2021-2022, and supports strategic information systems at 205 facilities in 10 district health offices.

LSO.note: Document states nothing on school internet or curriculum.
